mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in consumer price inflation above 0.5 percentage points per month triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and acceleration in nonfarm payroll growth indicates a tightening labor market that increases inflation expectations and prompts monetary policy tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS accelerates, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, strong housing starts and robust retail sales indicate sustained consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST and RSAFS are both above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates economic softening that triggers expectations of monetary policy accommodation, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and acceleration in real GDP growth indicates robust aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST and GDPC1 both increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes, a rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt expectations of future monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of high-inflation periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.
